US8509827B2.description: A patent document titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data based on a query.

Context-Data Acquisition And Ranking.description: A method and system for determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to specified parameters.

Context-Data Type.description: A classification of context data determined from a query, where the type provides information about an environment of a mobile device and may be determined by the meaning of a term of a short message.

Context-Data Source.description: A source that provides a particular context-data type and from which context data is requested; sources may be ranked according to specified parameters such as pecuniary cost.

Short Message.description: A message received from a mobile device by a server, from which a context-data type may be determined and to which received context data may be appended or encoded.

Mobile Device.description: A device that generates a short message or query and to which received context data may be provided; its state may serve as a specified parameter.

Server.description: A server that receives a short message from a mobile device and performs context-data type determination, source identification, ranking, and request generation.

Recipient Mobile Device.description: A mobile device that receives context data, to which received context data may be provided, and to which a short message and context data may be forwarded.

Specified Parameter.description: A parameter used to rank context-data sources or context data, which may include a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, or a state of an available communication network.

Pecuniary Cost.description: A specified parameter representing the monetary cost to acquire context data from a context-data source.

Database.description: A storage available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored.

Database Server.description: A server whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to access stored context data.

Uniform Resource Identifier (URI).description: An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device.

Markup Language.description: A language used to encode received context data into a short message.

Metadata Instructions.description: Instructions appended to a short message to query a database for received context data.

Communication Network.description: An available communication network whose state may serve as a specified parameter for ranking.
